title: postmortem template variables
description: Values for templates/postmortem.md.j2 and templates/postmortem.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from postmortem.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

action_1.title: Action 1
action_1.description: What is the first follow-up action? One concrete change somebody can finish, not 'improve monitoring'.

action_2.title: Action 2
action_2.description: What is the second follow-up action?

detect_min.title: Detect min
detect_min.description: How many minutes passed between the incident starting and anyone knowing? This is the number that argues for a new detector.

due_1.title: Due 1
due_1.description: By when is that first action due, as YYYY-MM-DD? A follow-up with no date is a follow-up that does not happen.

due_2.title: Due 2
due_2.description: By when is that second action due, as YYYY-MM-DD?

eval_after.title: Eval after
eval_after.description: Which eval set version gates releases now? If it did not change, this incident added no guard.

eval_before.title: Eval before
eval_before.description: Which eval set version was gating releases before the incident?

eval_guard_description.title: Eval guard description
eval_guard_description.description: What does that eval case assert, in one sentence a reader can check against the narrative above?

eval_guard_path.title: Eval guard path
eval_guard_path.description: Where does the new eval case live that would have caught this? A postmortem whose guard has no path is a postmortem with no guard.

fix_summary.title: Fix summary
fix_summary.description: What actually fixed it, and why that fix and not another? A fix with no reasoning cannot be reviewed when it is reverted six months from now.

incident_commander.title: Incident commander
incident_commander.description: Who ran this incident? One named human who held the decision, so a reader with a question knows whose account of the timeline this is.

incident_end.title: Incident end
incident_end.description: When did the incident end - the moment the last affected user stopped being affected, not the moment the fix merged?

incident_id.title: Incident id
incident_id.description: Which incident is this? Use the id the pager, the status page and the ticket already share, so the postmortem can be found from any of them.

incident_start.title: Incident start
incident_start.description: When did the incident begin - the moment the bad behaviour started, not the moment somebody noticed? If those differ, the gap is the detection number below.

mitigate_min.title: Mitigate min
mitigate_min.description: How many minutes from detection to users stopping being harmed - the throttle, the kill-switch, the rollback?

model_after.title: Model after
model_after.description: Which model version is serving now? Same value as before when the model was not the axis that moved - say so rather than leaving it blank.

model_before.title: Model before
model_before.description: Which model version was serving before the incident?

narrative.title: Narrative
narrative.description: What happened, told as a sequence a stranger could follow? Blameless means naming systems and decisions, not omitting who decided - write actions, never adjectives about people.

owner_1.title: Owner 1
owner_1.description: Who owns that first action? One named human who has agreed to it, not the team that will inherit it.

prompt_after.title: Prompt after
prompt_after.description: Which prompt revision is live now?

prompt_before.title: Prompt before
prompt_before.description: Which prompt revision was live before - the SHA or version, not a description of it?

resolve_min.title: Resolve min
resolve_min.description: How many minutes from detection to full resolution, with the mitigation removed and normal service restored?

revenue_impact.title: Revenue impact
revenue_impact.description: What did this cost in revenue, in USD? Include refunds and credits actually issued, not projected churn.

root_cause_class.title: Root cause class
root_cause_class.description: Which class of root cause was it - model change, prompt change, data drift, retrieval, tooling, upstream provider? The class is what makes postmortems comparable across a quarter.

system_version.title: System version
system_version.description: Which version of the system was in production when this began? The thing a reader would check out to reproduce the state.

users_affected.title: Users affected
users_affected.description: How many users saw the bad behaviour? An estimate with its method beats a blank; write 'unknown' only if you also say why it cannot be counted.
